speaker: Doctor
text: That pain severity waking you from sleep is concerning; does the joint feel warm or red to the touch, and do you experience any stiffness or locking movements? Also, have you recently engaged in a new or repetitive physical activity?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Juvenile Arthritis (Oligoarticular). The clinical picture of severe, sleep-disrupting knee pain and swelling in a young male, unresponsive to NSAIDs, is highly suggestive of an inflammatory etiology. Given the high probability of an underlying autoimmune process, I will now request specific tests to confirm the diagnosis.
